gloss: garbage truck; collection vehicle; refuse truck

definitions.gloss: garbage truck; collection vehicle; refuse truck
definitions.explanation: a vehicle used to collect and transport waste, recyclables, or other materials

examples.japanese: {収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}が{来|く}る{前|まえ}にゴミを{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I put out the trash before the garbage truck comes.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}{早|はや}くに{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard the sound of the garbage truck early in the morning.

examples.japanese: ゴミの{分別|ぶんべつ}が{正|ただ}しくないと、{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}に{回収|かいしゅう}してもらえないことがある。
examples.english: If the trash is not sorted properly, the collection truck may not pick it up.

notes:
Composed of {収集|しゅうしゅう} (collection/gathering) and {車|しゃ} (vehicle). The full formal term is ゴミ{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ} (garbage collection vehicle). In daily conversation, people often say ゴミ{収集|しゅうしゅう} (garbage collection) or simply refer to the truck coming. Japan has strict garbage separation rules, and knowing collection schedules and procedures is essential for daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴミ{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}: garbage truck
- {収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}が{来|く}る: the collection truck comes
- {収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}の{時間|じかん}: collection truck schedule
- {資源|しげん}{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}: recycling collection vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ゴミ{収集|しゅうしゅう}: garbage collection — the service itself, not the vehicle
- {清掃車|せいそうしゃ}: cleaning vehicle — broader term that can include street sweepers
- パッカー{車|しゃ}: compactor truck — technical term for the type of truck used
